TestPerPartitionRateLimiter::test_per_pa.description: 2-node cluster, RF=1 table WITH per_partition_rate_limit max_reads/writes_per_second=10. Hammers one partition with sequential inserts for 20s, then selects for 20s, catching RateLimitReached. Asserts replica metric total_{writes,reads}_rate_limited is non-zero on some node, the summed scylla_storage_proxy_coordinator_{write,read}_rate_limited equals the client-observed rejection count exactly, and accepted rate is within (0.9x, 2x) of the limit. Guards per-partition rate limiting (scylla dab56b82, 5.1) and the coordinator metric accounting (scylladb#11651).
